## Variable definition /Project start

```{r}
files<-c("brain_a.s_trimmed.sorted.count.txt","brain_3b.s_trimmed.sorted.count.txt","brain_3c.s_trimmed.sorted.count.txt","heart_5a.s_trimmed.sorted.count.txt","heart_5b.s_trimmed.sorted.count.txt","heart_6a.s_trimmed.sorted.count.txt")

organs<-c("brain","brain","brain","heart","heart","heart")

samples<-c("brain_a","brain_3b","brain_3c","heart_5a","heart_5b","heart_6a")

```

## create a DESeqDataSet in DESeq2 for PCA plots and heatmaps
```{r}
sampleTable<-data.frame(sampleName=samples, fileName=files, condition=organs)
project_data1 <- DESeqDataSetFromHTSeqCount(sampleTable=sampleTable, design= ~ condition)
```
## Transforming the Dataset with rlog
```{r}
rlog_data <- rlog(project_data1, blind = FALSE)
```
## Creating Data heat map
```{r}
sampleDist <- dist(t(assay(rlog_data)))
sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDist)
#sampleDistMatrix
colors <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(7, "Greens")))(255)
rownames(sampleDistMatrix) <- rownames(colData(rlog_data))
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) <- rownames(colData(rlog_data))
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix, clustering_distance_rows = sampleDist, clustering_distance_cols = sampleDist, col=colors)
```


## Making PCA plot
# Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a method for reducing dimensionality of datasets to bring out differences among samples
```{r}
PCA_model <- plotPCA(rlog_data, intgroup = c("condition", "sizeFactor"))
PCA_model
```

## Gene Heatmap
```{r}
geneVars <- rowVars(assay(rlog_data))
geneVarsOrdered <- order(geneVars, decreasing = TRUE)
topVarGenes <- head(geneVarsOrdered, 50)
mat <- assay(rlog_data)[topVarGenes, ]
mat <- mat - rowMeans(mat)
df <- as.data.frame(colData(rlog_data)[, c("condition", "sizeFactor")])
clear_col_names <- rownames(colData(rlog_data))
paste(rownames(colData(rlog_data)), rlog_data$condition, sep = ".")
top100_genes_heatmap <- pheatmap(mat, annotation_col = df, labels_col = clear_col_names)
```


## DGEList object in edgeR for differential expression analysis: Differential Expression analysis starts here
```{r}
project_data2 <-readDGE(files, group=organs, labels=samples)
filtered_project_data2 <- project_data2[!rowSums(project_data2$count == 0), ]
sf <- calcNormFactors(filtered_project_data2)
plotMDS(sf)
```
## BCV plot
```{r}
sf <- estimateDisp(sf)
sf$common.dispersion
#Creating a BCV Plot
plotBCV(sf)
```
## Smear plot
```{r}
et <- exactTest(sf, pair=c("brain","heart"))

summary(de <- decideTestsDGE(et))
#D. Visualizing Differentially Expressed Genes
detags <- rownames(sf)[as.logical(de)]
plotSmear(et, de.tags=detags)
abline(h=c(-1, 1), col="green")
```
